description: Create a prompt label for tagging prompt versions such as production, staging, or experiment. Requires either organisation_id or workspace_id to set scope, returns the new label id, and does not assign it to any versions yet.

color_code.description: Hex format, e.g. '#FF5733'. Optional — omit for default color.

organisation_id.description: Organisation ID to create the label in

workspace_id.description: Workspace ID to create the label in

name: create_prompt_label

data.description: Structured success payload when ok is true

error.description: Structured error payload when ok is false

ok.description: Whether the tool call succeeded and returned structured data
